subheadline: My name is Garrison Brooks. I am an Industrial Designer with over 20 years of professional practice experience. I have developed successful display programs in a variety of industries, from beverage to electronics to home improvement and have worked with materials and manufacturing processes of all kinds. I leverage this knowledge with the latest in technology to quickly and effectively respond to wide ranging creative briefs and develop targeted solutions ready to be developed and produced by manufacturers.
methodologyTitle: The Method: Rocks in a Tumbler
methodologyParagraph1: For every project, I generate 15-30 rapid concept sketches—not to show off volume, but because the right solution rarely appears in the first three ideas.
methodologyParagraph2: These concepts collide with each other, with client constraints, with manufacturing realities. The friction reveals what works.
